common: Faithful production 2D puppet reconstruction. Single isolated sprite, genuine transparency, high resolution shaded illustration, no labels or sheets. Preserve reference colors and distinctive details.

parts.head: Complete head with segmented horns, hair, forehead gem, ears, full blank muzzle/chin. Remove eyebrows, mouth and teeth; genuine transparent narrow half-lidded eye holes; no eyeballs, neck or wings.
parts.torso: Chest/neck only, orange faceted gem, silver chevron neck armor, dark side scales and orange seams. Reconstruct hidden upper neck, no head or wings.
parts.wing-left: Image-left wing only, orange shoulder and tip joints, dark curved spar, burgundy membrane and orange flame markings; root on right.
parts.wing-right: Image-right wing only, matching joints, spar, burgundy membrane and flame markings; root on left.
parts.iris: Single round reddish copper iris with round black pupil and white highlight, transparency outside circle; no sclera or lids.
parts.sclera: Single creamy white oval background with upper gray shading; no iris, pupil or black center.
parts.brow-left: Detached image-left angular dark plum metallic eyebrow, lavender highlight; slopes toward right/nose.
parts.brow-right: Detached image-right angular dark plum metallic eyebrow, lavender highlight; slopes toward left/nose.
parts.lid-upper: Opaque dark plum rounded trapezoid curtain, twice as wide as tall, no eyes, holes, gems or patterns.
parts.lid-lower: Opaque dark plum rounded bowl/trapezoid curtain, twice as wide as tall, no eyes, holes, gems or patterns.
parts.fang: One ivory fang, thick rounded top and tapered downward point, no gum, lip or second tooth.
